; docformat = 'rst' ;+ ; Calculate WCS coordinates OBSGEO-{X,Y,Z} from lat, long, height. ; ; Based on Rots et al. (2015), 2015A&A...574A..36R, WCS paper IV, ; section 4.1.3. ; ; :Categories: ; ; SST pipeline ; ; ; :Author: ; ; Mats Löfdahl, ISP ; ; ; :Returns: ; ; The array [OBSGEO-X,OBSGEO-Y,OBSGEO-Z] ; ; :Params: ; ; B : in, type=float ; ; The latitude in degrees, north positive. ; ; L : in, type=float ; ; The longitude in degrees, east positive. ; ; H : in, type=float ; ; The altitude in meters. ; ; ; :History: ; ; 2017-03-06 : MGL. First version. ; ; ;- function red_obsgeo, B, L, H a = 6378140.d ; [m] semi-major axis f = 1d/298.2577d ; "inverse of the inverse flattening" d2r = !dpi/180d e2 = 2d*f - f*f sinB = sin(B*d2r) & cosB = cos(B*d2r) sinL = sin(L*d2r) & cosL = cos(L*d2r) N = a/sqrt(1d - e2*sinB^2) X = (N+H) * cosL * cosB Y = (N+H) * sinL * cosB Z = (N * (1d - e2) + H) * sinB ; print, 'OBSGEO-{B,L,H} =', B, L, H ; print, 'OBSGEO-{X,Y,Z} =', X, Y, Z return, [X, Y, Z] end tmp = red_obsgeo(28.7305802d, -17.896868d, 2426d) end
